sectionHeader.title: Everything else SaleLinx does.
sectionHeader.body: Grouped by what you actually do with it. Skim the categories or jump straight to the feature you came for.

headlines.title: What sellers install SaleLinx for.
headlines.description: Most people come for one of these. The rest of the features are below.

crosslist.title: Crosslist Depop and Vinted in one click
crosslist.body: Pick a listing, hit crosslist, and the other marketplace's form fills itself in. Categories, sizes and conditions are translated for you, so the same item goes live on both shops in seconds.

relist.title: Relist to stay on top
relist.body: Recreate tired listings with tweaked photos and titles, then delete the originals so they climb back up the search results. Run it yourself, or let it run on its own every few hours.

restocker.title: Never oversell across shops
restocker.body: Sells on Depop? SaleLinx removes the same item from Vinted in the same minute. Works the other way too, so you can list the same stock on both shops without worrying about double sales.

oneInbox.title: Offers and messages in one inbox
oneInbox.body: Every offer and every buyer message from both shops, merged into a single list. Set rules to auto-accept or counter incoming offers, so you only step in for the conversations that matter.

labels.title: Shipping labels, ready to print in batches
labels.body: Download and merge label PDFs for a whole day of orders, so you can run them through the printer in one go instead of clicking through every sale.

ctaSection.title: Start in the browser you already sell from.

listings.title: Listings and inventory
listings.blurb: Every listing from both shops in one place, kept safe and synced everywhere you use SaleLinx.

dashboard.label: All your stock in one grid
dashboard.detail: Both shops side by side. Sort by date, price or status, and filter down to exactly what you need.

linkAccounts.label: Link your shops once
linkAccounts.detail: Sign in to Depop and Vinted as you normally would. SaleLinx picks up the session, no passwords to re-enter.

backup.label: Your shop, safely backed up
backup.detail: Every listing is stored in the cloud and encrypted, so a closed laptop or a marketplace mistake never costs you a sale.

sync.label: Switch laptops, keep your setup
sync.detail: Your settings, rules and shop links follow you to any device you sign in on.

multilanguage.label: Use it in your language
multilanguage.detail: Available in English, French, Spanish and German, with light and dark themes.

crosslisting.title: Crosslisting
crosslisting.blurb: Write a listing once and post it to both marketplaces at the same time. The tricky stuff like categories and sizes is translated for you.

bidirectional.label: Crosslist Depop and Vinted, both ways
bidirectional.detail: Pick any listing on either marketplace and SaleLinx fills out the other side's form for you.

autoMap.label: Categories and sizes translated for you
autoMap.detail: Depop's tags become Vinted's, and the other way round. No mapping tables to set up.

csvImport.label: Bulk-import from a CSV
csvImport.detail: Already have a stocklist in a spreadsheet? Upload it once and SaleLinx maps the fields automatically.

shopDesigner.label: Design your Depop shop, drag-and-drop
shopDesigner.detail: Rearrange the layout of your Depop profile in the panel without touching the Depop site itself.

visibility.title: Visibility and audience
visibility.blurb: Stay near the top of search and reach the buyers most likely to spend with you, without doing it by hand.

refresher.label: Push every listing back to the top
refresher.detail: Re-saves your stock from the bottom up in one click, so the order you carefully arranged is kept.

scheduler.label: Set it and forget it
scheduler.detail: Refresh runs on its own every 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24 hours. Pick the cadence, walk away.

followBot.label: Grow your following, hands-off
followBot.detail: Follow a competitor's audience, your past buyers, or anyone who liked an item. Five ways to target the right people.

filters.label: Skip or always keep specific accounts
filters.detail: Add usernames to a blacklist or whitelist so the bot leaves friends, brands or rivals alone.

deadStock.label: Spot what isn't selling
deadStock.detail: SaleLinx flags stale listings and suggests what to do with them: refresh, drop the price or relist.

autoMarkdown.label: Drop prices on stale items, automatically
autoMarkdown.detail: Schedule percentage price drops on listings that have been sitting too long, to nudge them back into search.

activityLog.label: See every action as it happens
activityLog.detail: Watch SaleLinx work in real time. Filter, pause, stop anything mid-run, and export the log if you need it.

sales.title: Sales and messaging
sales.blurb: Offers, messages, labels and post-sale cleanup in one place, with rules to handle the repetitive stuff.

offersInbox.label: Accept, counter or decline in one place
offersInbox.detail: Every offer from both shops shows up in one inbox, so you don't bounce between tabs to keep up.

autoOffers.label: Auto-reply to offers
autoOffers.detail: Set rules like 'accept anything above 80 percent' or 'always counter at 90 percent' and let SaleLinx handle the rest.

messages.label: All buyer messages, one list
messages.detail: Depop and Vinted conversations merged into a single inbox, so nothing gets missed.

shipping.label: Print shipping labels in batches
shipping.detail: Download and merge label PDFs for a whole day of orders, ready to print and stick.

relister.label: Refresh a listing's search rank
relister.detail: Recreate a tired listing with tweaked photos and title, then delete the original so it climbs back up the results.

restocker.label: Never oversell across shops
restocker.detail: Sell an item on one marketplace and SaleLinx pulls the matching listing from the other, automatically.

sectionHeader.title: Pick a plan. Switch any time. Cancel any time.
sectionHeader.body: Every plan ships the same extension. Higher tiers raise monthly caps and unlock the heavier automations like auto-offers and restocker.
